header.name: WorkcenterHistoryScheduler
header.description:
ISO 22400-Compliant Workcenter State Change Generator

This node generates realistic workcenter state changes for manufacturing simulation, strictly adhering to ISO 22400-2 standards for OEE calculation.

Core Functions:

- Processes workcenters in batches to simulate operational state transitions

- Maintains open history records (one active state per workcenter)

- Closes previous states and creates new states atomically

- Applies weighted randomness for realistic production patterns

- Enforces ISO 22400-compliant mode-state relationships

ISO 22400-2 Compliance:

The mode-state transition logic ensures proper OEE classification:

- PRODUCTION mode: Only states where equipment actively produces (running, running-slow)

- DISABLED mode: Unscheduled downtime states (faulted, blocked, starved, e-stopped)

- SETUP mode: Planned minor stops within production time (changeover, warmup, cleaning)

- IDLE mode: Planned idle time within production schedule (stopped)

- MAINTENANCE mode: Scheduled maintenance outside production (maintenance, offline)

- CLEANING mode: Deep cleaning activities (cleaning, offline)

- NO-SCHEDULE mode: Outside production calendar (offline)

- ENGINEERING mode: Engineering/testing activities outside production (stopped, offline)

State Transition Rules:

- Blocked/Starved/E-Stopped → Always classified as DOWNTIME (disabled mode)

- Production mode → Only allows actively producing states

- Minor stops (setup/changeover) → Counted within planned production time

- Scheduled maintenance → Excluded from OEE calculations

- Unscheduled workcenters → Automatically transition to no-schedule mode

Duration Calculation:

- Closes open records with precise ISO 8601 duration (PT#H#M#S)

- Calculates durationMinutes as decimal (rounded to 3 places)

- Uses occurAt and endAt timestamps for accurate period tracking

Batch Processing:

Generates three separate batch arrays for sequential execution:

1. Close Batches - Updates existing open records with endAt/duration

2. Create Batches - Inserts new history records with current state

3. Update Batches - Updates workcenter current state fields

Output Structure:

Returns array of batch objects, each containing:

- batchType: 'close', 'create', or 'update'

- batchIndex: Sequential batch number

- historyToClose/historyToCreate/workcentersToUpdate: Mutation payloads

- stats: Execution metadata (timezone, timestamp, record counts)

Execution Order:

Close → Create → Update ensures data integrity and prevents orphaned open records.

Error Handling:

- Validates required modes (no-schedule) and states (offline) exist

- Falls back to first available mode/state if required values missing

- Logs warnings when fallbacks are used

- Returns null if no batches generated (no state changes needed)

Configuration Parameters:

- batchSize: Number of workcenters per batch (default: 10)

- changeProb: Probability of state change per execution (default: 0.30)

- minProductionRatio: Minimum fraction in production mode (default: 0.40)

Schedule Integration:

- Uses currentScheduleByGroup mapping from upstream JSONata transform

- Applies scheduleId from active schedule for the workcenter's schedule group

- Transitions unscheduled workcenters to no-schedule mode automatically

This engine forms the core of the manufacturing simulation system, generating realistic operational data for OEE analysis, downtime tracking, and production monitoring dashboards.
